truenas-zfs-enterprise.چه زمانی TrueNAS انتخاب مناسبی است و چه: When is TrueNAS a suitable choice, and when is it not?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.TrueNAS انتخاب مناسبی است اگر به کنترل ک: TrueNAS suits teams that need full control over storage, ZFS, snapshots, replication, SMB/NFS/iSCSI, hardware flexibility and manageable costs, and have storage, networking and recovery expertise.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.انتخاب مناسبی نیست اگر تیمی برای مدیریت: It is unsuitable when no team can manage ZFS, only mismatched disks without backups are available, an appliance is expected to require no design, the web UI would be Internet-facing, or very high availability is needed without HA and a second site. A supported appliance, managed storage or a vendor-based solution may be more appropriate.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.آیا RAIDZ و Snapshot جای نسخهٔ پشتیبان ر: Do RAIDZ and snapshots replace backups?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.خیر. RAIDZ برای تحمل خرابی دیسک و Snapsh: No. RAIDZ tolerates disk failures and snapshots return data to a point in time. Total pool failure, malicious deletion and site incidents require independent off-site copies.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.تفاوت Dataset و ZVOL چیست؟: What is the difference between a dataset and a ZVOL?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.Dataset یک فایل‌سیستم با سهمیه، ACL و Sn: A dataset is a filesystem with independent quotas, ACLs and snapshots, used for SMB or NFS shares. A ZVOL is a block device, typically used behind an iSCSI extent.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.برای ماشین‌های مجازی Mirror مناسب‌تر است: Are mirrors or RAIDZ2 better for virtual machines?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.انتخاب به IOPS، تأخیر، ظرفیت و الگوی بار: The choice depends on IOPS, latency, capacity and workload. Mirror VDEVs usually suit random VM workloads; RAIDZ2 provides capacity and tolerance of two disk failures per VDEV. Test the final choice with a real workload.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.چرا دیسک Boot باید از دیسک‌های Pool جدا: Why should boot disks be separate from pool disks?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.نصب TrueNAS دیسک انتخاب‌شده را پاک می‌کن: TrueNAS installation erases the selected disk. Separating boot and data reduces selection mistakes and role conflicts. Verify the destination disk model and serial number before installation.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.چگونه دسترسی به SMB را محدود کنیم؟: How do we restrict SMB access?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.Dataset مستقل بسازید، ACL را به گروه‌های: Create a separate dataset, assign ACLs to required groups and restrict network access to the service. Test read, write and deletion using both authorized and unauthorized users.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.آیا فعال کردن Deduplication همیشه فضای ب: Does deduplication always save more space?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.خیر. نتیجه به تکرار واقعی داده‌ها و مناب: No. Results depend on actual duplicate data and system resources. Memory and performance costs can exceed savings. Do not enable it without measurements and tests.
truenas-zfs-enterprise.موفق بودن Replication برای اطمینان از با: Is successful replication sufficient to prove recoverability?
truenas-zfs-enterprise.خیر. علاوه بر بررسی Job و Snapshotهای مق: No. Check the job and destination snapshots, then actually restore a file or dataset. Retain destination retention settings and encryption keys separately from the primary server.

truenas-zfs-enterprise.از Dashboard و zpool status وضعیت را برر: Check the dashboard and zpool status, identify the failed disk by serial number, and confirm backup health. Replace it through a supported TrueNAS UI procedure and monitor resilver progress.

fortigate-sd-wan-load-balancing-failover.داشتن دو اینترنت زمانی به دسترس‌پذیری با: Two Internet links improve availability only when the firewall distinguishes an active port, a responding gateway and a usable Internet path. Traditional routing can use a link monitor; the limitation discussed here is ECMP or static routing without monitoring and service policy.

fortigate-sd-wan-load-balancing-failover.در این سناریو Load Balancing یعنی تقسیم: Here, load balancing distributes connections or connection groups across WANs. Some users reach the Internet through WAN1 and others through WAN2. FortiGate tracks sessions using addresses, ports and protocol; the selected path and NAT translation form part of session state.
fortigate-sd-wan-load-balancing-failover.این طراحی، Bonding دو ISP نیست. یک TCP S: This is not ISP bonding. A normal TCP session is not split across WANs and cannot reach the sum of 200 and 100 Mbps. Many independent connections can use both links. Actual speed depends on the selected WAN, destination server, RTT, congestion, FortiGate processing capacity and security inspection.
fortigate-sd-wan-load-balancing-failover.یک Download Manager که چند اتصال TCP مست: A download manager opening several independent TCP connections may use both WANs with some algorithms. With source-destination IP hashing, connections sharing an IP pair usually take one WAN. Even a multi-connection download therefore need not use both links simultaneously.
